data.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
data.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Small and marginal landholding farmer families
data.benefits: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year transferred in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months directly into bank accounts via DBT.
required_documents: Active Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar NPCI seeded)
Mobile number linked with Aadhaar for e-KYC
data.application_procedure: 1. Visit pmkisan.gov.in and click New Farmer Registration. 2. Enter Rural/Urban Farmer, Aadhaar Number, and Mobile Number. 3. Enter land ownership details. 4. Complete Aadhaar OTP e-KYC.

data.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
data.ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services)
target_beneficiaries: Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises and entrepreneurs
data.benefits: Collateral-free institutional loans up to ₹20 Lakhs across 3 categories: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakhs), and Tarun (₹5 Lakhs to ₹20 Lakhs).
required_documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN Card)
Business establishment / Registration proof or Udyam certificate
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply online via Udyami Mitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or visit any commercial bank branch. 2. Select loan category.

data.name: Stand-Up India Scheme for Women and SC/ST Entrepreneurs
data.ministry: Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: Women entrepreneurs and SC/ST business founders
data.benefits: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises.
required_documents: Proof of Identity & Address (Aadhaar, Voter ID)
Rent/Lease agreement or land title for project location
data.application_procedure: 1. Register at standupmitra.in. 2. Submit online loan application mapped to a scheduled commercial bank branch.

data.name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
data.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
target_beneficiaries: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools (18 trades)
data.benefits: Collateral-free enterprise loans at concessional 5% interest (up to ₹1 Lakh in 1st tranche, ₹2 Lakhs in 2nd tranche) + ₹15,000 toolkit e-voucher + skill training with ₹500/day stipend.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card and active mobile number
data.application_procedure: 1. Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and mobile. 2. Biometric authentication. 3. Three-stage verification.

data.name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
data.ministry: National Health Authority / Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Bottom 40% vulnerable and poor families identified by SECC 2011 + Senior Citizens aged 70+
data.benefits: Comprehensive cashless health coverage of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization across empaneled public and private hospitals nationwide.
required_documents: PM-JAY beneficiary letter or mobile number linked with e-KYC
data.application_procedure: 1. Check eligibility at beneficiary.nha.gov.in or Ayushman App. 2. Complete Aadhaar OTP e-KYC. 3. Download Ayushman Card.

data.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
data.ministry: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) / Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: Unorganized sector workers aged 18 to 40 years
data.benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 from age 60 until demise, with same pension to spouse and return of pension corpus to nominee.
required_documents: Savings Bank Account / Post Office Savings Account
Mobile number for auto-debit SMS alerts
data.application_procedure: 1. Approach your bank branch or access NetBanking. 2. Fill APY registration form and choose pension slab. 3. Provide auto-debit consent.

data.name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students (CSSS)
data.ministry: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
target_beneficiaries: Top 20th percentile class 12 pass students pursuing regular degree courses
data.benefits: ₹12,000 per annum for the first three years of undergraduate study and ₹20,000 per annum at the postgraduate stage directly disbursed through PFMS DBT.
required_documents: Class 12th passing marksheet with percentile confirmation
College Admission Bonafide and Fee Receipt
Aadhaar Card and seeded bank account
data.application_procedure: 1. Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). 2. Submit application under Department of Higher Education. 3. Verification by College Nodal Officer.

data.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students (Technical Degree/Diploma)
data.ministry: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education
target_beneficiaries: Girl students admitted to 1st year of technical degree or diploma courses
data.benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study towards college fee payment, computer, stationery, books, and equipment purchase.
required_documents: Family Income Certificate issued by competent Revenue Authority (<= ₹8 Lakhs)
Aadhaar Card and Student Bank Passbook
data.application_procedure: 1. Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). 2. Fill student demographic details. 3. Upload income certificate and CAP allotment order.

data.name: Centrally Sponsored Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
data.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
target_beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste students studying in recognized post-matric institutions
data.benefits: Compulsory non-refundable fees paid directly to student via DBT + Annual maintenance allowance ranging from ₹2,500 to ₹13,500 depending on course group.
required_documents: Self-attested caste certificate issued by competent revenue authority
Valid Income Certificate (Annual family income <= 2.5 Lakhs)
Aadhaar Card linked to Bank Account (Aadhaar seeding / NPCI mapping mandatory)
data.application_procedure: 1. Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). 2. Submit e-KYC via Aadhaar OTP. 3. Select state of domicile and fill application.

data.name: Ishan Uday Special Scholarship Scheme for North Eastern Region (NER)
data.ministry: University Grants Commission (UGC) / Ministry of Education
target_beneficiaries: Students with domicile of North Eastern States admitted to 1st year degree courses
data.benefits: ₹5,400 per month for general degree courses and ₹7,800 per month for technical/medical/professional courses directly disbursed via DBT for the entire course duration.
required_documents: Domicile Certificate of any of the 8 North Eastern States (Assam, AP, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura)
Income Certificate issued by competent authority (<= ₹4,50,000)
College Admission Bonafide and Aadhaar Card
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply online on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) under UGC Schemes. 2. Verification by College Nodal Officer.

data.name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna
data.ministry: Department of Higher and Technical Education, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Students pursuing Higher and Professional Education in Maharashtra
data.benefits: 50% Tuition Fee & 50% Exam Fee reimbursement for general/EWS students admitted through CAP round.
required_documents: Income Certificate issued by Tahsildar (<= 8 Lakhs)
data.application_procedure: 1. Register on MahaDBT portal (mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in). 2. Complete Aadhaar authentication. 3. Upload documents.

data.name: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Vidyarthi Yojana (MMVY)
data.ministry: Department of Technical Education & Skill Development, Government of Madhya Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Meritorious students of MP securing >= 70% in MP Board or >= 85% in CBSE/ICSE in Class 12
data.benefits: 100% Tuition Fee reimbursement paid by state government for admission into Engineering, Medical, Law and premier institutes.
data.application_procedure: 1. Register at scholarship.mp.gov.in/Medhavi. 2. Verify Samagra ID. 3. Enter college course details.

data.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students (Technical Degree/Diploma)
data.ministry: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
target_beneficiaries: Citizens meeting eligibility criteria
data.benefits: ₹50,000 per annum towards payment of college fees, purchase of computers, stationeries, books, equipment, and exam fees.
required_documents: Mark sheet of standard X/XII or equivalent
Annual family income certificate issued by Tehsildar/competent authority (<= ₹8 Lakh)
Admission letter issued by State Directorate of Technical Education / CET
Tuition fee receipt paid to the AICTE approved institution
Declaration from parents that scholarship is availed for max 2 girl children
data.application_procedure: 1. Complete admission in 1st year or 2nd year (lateral entry) in AICTE approved institution. 2. Register on NSP or AICTE Pragati portal. 3. Enter admission details and bank details. 4. Upload fee receipt, income certificate and declaration. 5. Verified by College AICTE nodal officer.

data.name: National Fellowship for Other Backward Classes (NFOBC)
data.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
target_beneficiaries: Citizens meeting eligibility criteria
data.benefits: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) @ ₹37,000/month for first 2 years + Senior Research Fellowship (SRF) @ ₹42,000/month for remaining 3 years + Contingency Grant.
required_documents: Valid UGC-NET or CSIR-NET qualification scorecard
OBC Non-Creamy Layer Certificate as per Central List
Master's Degree Marks Memo with minimum 55% marks
Ph.D Admission / Registration letter from recognized university
data.application_procedure: 1. Qualify UGC-NET/CSIR-NET in the respective subject. 2. Apply on the UGC NFOBC portal / myScheme integration link. 3. Provide NET registration number and research guide details. 4. University nodal verification.

data.name: Telangana Post-Matric Scholarships (RTF & MTF)
data.ministry: Backward Classes / SC Development / ST Welfare / Minorities Welfare Department
target_beneficiaries: Citizens meeting eligibility criteria
data.benefits: Full Tuition Fee Reimbursement (RTF) credited directly to colleges + Monthly Maintenance Allowance (MTF) to student bank accounts.
required_documents: Latest Income Certificate issued by MeeSeva (within 1 year)
Bonafide / Study Certificate from the institution
SSC Hall Ticket Number and Marks Memo
Intermediate / Degree Previous Year Marks Memo
CET Allotment Order for Convener Quota seats
data.application_procedure: 1. Visit the official Telangana ePASS portal. 2. Select Post-Matric Registration. 3. Enter SSC Hall Ticket and Academic details. 4. Upload MeeSeva income, caste and bonafide certificates. 5. Submit application and print acknowledgment to submit to college principal for institutional biometric verification.

data.name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students (CSSS)
data.ministry: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
target_beneficiaries: Citizens meeting eligibility criteria
data.benefits: ₹12,000 per annum at Graduation level for first 3 years, and ₹20,000 per annum at Post-Graduation level.
required_documents: Class 12 Marks Memo showing 80th percentile qualification
Proof of admission in recognized college/university
Bonafide certificate issued by Registrar / Principal
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply online through scholarships.gov.in during the open window. 2. Complete NSP applicant login using Class 12 Board Roll Number. 3. Select CSSS under Higher Education schemes. 4. Upload income certificate and institutional bonafide. 5. Institution verifies via NSP Institute Nodal Officer.

data.name: Chief Minister's Overseas Scholarship Scheme for Minorities / SC / ST / BC (Ambedkar Overseas Vidya Nidhi)
data.ministry: Welfare Departments, Government of Telangana
target_beneficiaries: Citizens meeting eligibility criteria
data.benefits: Grant of up to ₹20,00,000 (Twenty Lakhs) or actual fees/expenses whichever is less, payable in installments + one-way economy air ticket.
required_documents: Degree Certificate with minimum 60% marks or equivalent grade
Valid Score Card of GRE / GMAT and TOEFL / IELTS
I-20 / Admission Offer Letter from an accredited top ranking foreign university (USA, UK, Australia, Canada, Germany, Singapore, Japan)
Valid Passport and Student Visa Copy
MeeSeva Caste and Income Certificate (< ₹5.00 Lakhs per annum)
Residential / Nativity Certificate of Telangana State
data.application_procedure: 1. Access Telangana ePASS Overseas portal. 2. Enter personal and family income details. 3. Upload IELTS/GRE score cards, foreign admission offer letter and passport. 4. Attend State Level Screening Committee verification interview when scheduled. 5. Grant sanctioned in two installments linked to semester progress.

data.name: Ishan Uday Special Scholarship Scheme for North Eastern Region (NER)
data.ministry: University Grants Commission (UGC), Ministry of Education
target_beneficiaries: Citizens meeting eligibility criteria
data.benefits: ₹5,400 per month for general degree courses and ₹7,800 per month for technical/medical/professional courses.
required_documents: Domicile / Permanent Resident Certificate of NER states
Income certificate from competent authority (< ₹4.5 Lakhs)
Class 12 passing certificate and marks memo
data.application_procedure: 1. Verify domicile in Assam, Arunachal, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim or Tripura. 2. Register on NSP. 3. Select UGC Ishan Uday. 4. Submit certificates for online scrutiny by college and state authorities.

data.name: National Fellowship for Other Backward Classes (NFOBC)
data.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / UGC
target_beneficiaries: OBC students admitted to full-time regular M.Phil and Ph.D. degrees
data.benefits: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) of ₹37,000 per month for initial 2 years and Senior Research Fellowship (SRF) of ₹42,000 per month + annual contingency grant.
required_documents: Ph.D. / M.Phil Admission letter and joining report
Aadhaar Card and Bank Account details
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply via UGC Fellowship Portal (ugcnetonline.in). 2. Submit joining report endorsed by University Registrar.

data.name: Arunachal Pradesh State Tribal Stipend Scheme (APST)
data.ministry: Department of Higher and Technical Education, Government of Arunachal Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: APST Scheduled Tribe students pursuing higher & technical education
data.benefits: Monthly stipend up to ₹1,400 per month for hostellers and ₹1,000 for day scholars along with one-time book allowance.
required_documents: APST Certificate issued by Deputy Commissioner
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply online via National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) under State Schemes > Arunachal Pradesh. 2. Institutional verification.

data.name: Swaran Jayanti Utkrisht Chhatravriti Yojana
data.ministry: Department of Higher Education, Government of Himachal Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Top meritorious students of Class 10 and 12 in Himachal Pradesh
data.benefits: Direct financial scholarship of ₹18,000 per annum for undergraduate degree and ₹20,000 for professional courses.
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply on National Scholarship Portal under HP State Schemes. 2. Verification by School/College Principal.

data.name: Jharkhand e-Kalyan Post-Matric Scholarship
data.ministry: Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, Minority and Backward Class Welfare, Jharkhand
target_beneficiaries: Jharkhand domicile SC, ST and BC students in post-matric institutions
data.benefits: Complete tuition fee reimbursement directly to educational institutions + monthly maintenance stipend via e-Kalyan DBT.
required_documents: Residential Certificate of Jharkhand (SDO / CO issued)
Income Certificate issued after April 1 (<= 2.5 Lakhs)
data.application_procedure: 1. Register on e-Kalyan portal (ekalyan.cgg.gov.in). 2. Upload online certificates. 3. College & District Welfare Officer sanction.

data.name: Manipur State Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
data.ministry: Department of Tribal Affairs and Hills, Government of Manipur
target_beneficiaries: Tribal students of Manipur pursuing post-matriculation courses
data.benefits: Mandatory non-refundable tuition fees reimbursed + maintenance allowance up to ₹13,500/year via PFMS.
required_documents: Tribe / ST Certificate from Deputy Commissioner
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply online via Manipur State Scholarship Portal or NSP (scholarships.gov.in). 2. Institutional e-verification.

data.name: Meghalaya Chief Minister's Scholarship Scheme
data.ministry: Education Department, Government of Meghalaya
target_beneficiaries: Meritorious tribal and state domicile students of Meghalaya
data.benefits: Direct financial assistance of ₹10,000 to ₹30,000 per annum based on merit and course of study.
required_documents: Mark sheets of SSLC / HSSLC / Degree
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply via State Portal (megeducation.gov.in) or NSP. 2. Institute recommendation.

data.name: Mizoram Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe Students
data.ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of Mizoram
target_beneficiaries: Scheduled Tribe students native to Mizoram enrolled in post-matric courses
data.benefits: Reimbursement of compulsory course fees + monthly maintenance allowance ranging up to ₹1,200/month.
required_documents: Tribal / ST Certificate issued by Deputy Commissioner in Mizoram
data.application_procedure: 1. Register on NSP (scholarships.gov.in). 2. Submit Mizoram ST post-matric application. 3. College scrutiny.

data.name: Nagaland State Merit and Research Scholarship
data.ministry: Directorate of Higher Education, Government of Nagaland
target_beneficiaries: Indigenous Naga students who secured first division in qualifying exams / M.Phil & Ph.D.
data.benefits: Financial fellowship of ₹18,000/year for undergraduate students and ₹36,000/year for Ph.D. research scholars.
required_documents: Ph.D. registration letter & supervisor progress report
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply via Common Scholarship Portal Nagaland (scholarship.nagaland.gov.in). 2. Print verification slip for College Head.

data.name: Chief Minister's Merit Scholarship Scheme (CMMSS Sikkim)
data.ministry: Education Department, Government of Sikkim
target_beneficiaries: Meritorious Sikkimese students selected through state-wide merit screening
data.benefits: 100% Sponsorship for tuition, boarding, lodging and books in premier residential public schools across India.
required_documents: Certificate of Identification (COI) / Sikkim Subject Certificate
Class 5 / Class 10 state examination rank certificate
data.application_procedure: 1. Appear for CMMSS state entrance examination conducted by Education Department. 2. Counseling and school allotment.

data.name: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Scheme of Interest Subsidy on Educational Loans
data.ministry: Directorate of Higher Education, Andaman & Nicobar Administration
target_beneficiaries: Local students of Andaman and Nicobar Islands pursuing professional/technical higher education
data.benefits: 100% Interest subsidy on educational loans sanctioned by commercial banks during the moratorium period (course period + 1 year).
required_documents: Local Certificate / Domicile Certificate of A&N Islands
Bank Loan Sanction Letter from Scheduled Commercial Bank
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply via eService portal (eservice.andaman.gov.in). 2. Submit bank loan account statement and local certificate.

data.name: Chandigarh Administration Post-Matric Scholarship for College Students
data.ministry: Department of Higher Education, Chandigarh Administration
target_beneficiaries: SC and OBC students studying in recognized colleges/universities in Chandigarh UT
data.benefits: Full tuition fee reimbursement as approved by Panjab University / Administration + maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month.
required_documents: Caste Certificate issued by SDM Chandigarh
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) under State Schemes > Chandigarh. 2. College nodal verification.

data.name: Saraswati Sadhana Yojana & Higher Education Assistance
data.ministry: Department of Social Welfare, UT Administration of DNH & DD
data.state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
target_beneficiaries: Female and SC/ST students enrolled in high schools and colleges in DNH & DD
data.benefits: Free educational transport / cycle assistance for school girls + ₹25,000 annual scholarship for students pursuing degree courses.
required_documents: UT Domicile Certificate of DNH & DD
Aadhaar Card and Student Bank Passbook
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply via UT eServices portal (daman.nic.in / dnh.gov.in). 2. Submit physical copy to Head of Institution.

data.name: Rewa Student Financial Assistance Scheme
data.ministry: Higher Education Department, Administration of Union Territory of Ladakh
target_beneficiaries: Meritorious and economically disadvantaged students of UT of Ladakh
data.benefits: Direct financial reimbursement up to ₹1,00,000 for students qualifying premier national examinations (JEE, NEET, CLAT, UPSC prelims) and pursuing higher professional degrees outside Ladakh.
required_documents: Resident Certificate of UT of Ladakh
Qualifying competitive examination admit card & scorecard
College Admission Letter and Fee Receipt
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply online on Ladakh Higher Education portal (ladakh.gov.in). 2. Verified by Deputy Commissioner Leh / Kargil.

data.name: Lakshadweep Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Native ST Students
data.ministry: Department of Education, Union Territory of Lakshadweep
target_beneficiaries: Native inhabitant Scheduled Tribe students of Lakshadweep studying in mainland colleges
data.benefits: 100% Full course fee paid + monthly hostel and mess subsidy + complimentary sea passage/travel concession between islands and mainland Kochi/Calicut.
required_documents: Lakshadweep Island Native Scheduled Tribe Certificate
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply through Lakshadweep Education Office at Kochi or online at lakshadweep.gov.in / NSP. 2. Director of Education verification.

data.name: Perunthalaivar Kamarajar Financial Assistance Scheme
data.ministry: Directorate of Higher and Technical Education, Government of Puducherry
target_beneficiaries: Puducherry residents admitted through CENTAC to professional medical/engineering colleges
data.benefits: Direct payment of tuition fees up to ₹2,50,000 per annum for MBBS and ₹25,000 to ₹50,000 for B.Tech directly to CENTAC colleges on behalf of the student.
required_documents: Residence / Domicile Certificate of Puducherry (5 years continuous residence)
CENTAC Allotment Order and Fee structure
Aadhaar Card and Student Bank Passbook
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply online via dhte.py.gov.in. 2. Upload CENTAC allotment letter and Tahsildar income certificate. 3. College scrutiny.

data.name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
data.ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
target_beneficiaries: Houseless rural families and those living in kutcha / dilapidated houses
data.benefits: Financial grant of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/IAP areas for construction of a permanent pucca house with toilet facility under SBM.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
data.application_procedure: 1. Identification through SECC and Awaas+ survey verified by Gram Sabha. 2. Geo-tagged photographs of existing house. 3. Sanction by BDO.

data.name: Telangana Mahila Education & Marriage Assistance (Shaadi Mubarak / Kalyana Lakshmi)
data.ministry: Scheduled Castes / BC / Minority Welfare Department, Telangana
target_beneficiaries: Citizens meeting eligibility criteria
data.benefits: One-time financial assistance of ₹1,00,116 directly credited to the bride / mother's account to empower education and prevent early marriage.
required_documents: Bride's age proof (Minimum 18 years - SSC Memo or Birth Certificate)
MeeSeva Income Certificate (< ₹2,00,000 in urban, ₹1,50,000 in rural)
Aadhaar card of bride and groom
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply via Telangana ePASS Kalyana Lakshmi section. 2. Submit bride and parents' biometric details at MeeSeva. 3. Revenue Divisional Officer (RDO) / MRO verification.

data.name: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP) Post-Matric Scholarship
data.ministry: Social Welfare / Tribal Welfare / Backward Classes Welfare Department, Karnataka
target_beneficiaries: Karnataka domicile students studying post-matric courses
data.benefits: Full college tuition fee reimbursement + annual maintenance and hostel fee allowance credited via DBT.
required_documents: RD Number for Caste & Income Certificate (Nadakacheri)
Aadhaar Number seeded with bank account (NPCI mapping)
data.application_procedure: 1. Login to ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in. 2. Enter Kutumba ID. 3. Enter RD certificate number. 4. Complete e-attestation.

data.name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Pudhumai Penn)
data.ministry: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Tamil Nadu
target_beneficiaries: Girl students from government schools pursuing higher education
data.benefits: Monthly financial incentive of ₹1,000 credited directly to the student's bank account until successful completion of degree.
required_documents: Government School Study Proof (Class 6th to 12th in TN Govt Schools)
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply via institution helpdesk on penkalvi.tn.gov.in. 2. Verification of school EMIS records.

data.name: Jagananna Vidya Deevena (RTF Full Fee Reimbursement)
data.ministry: Higher Education & Social Welfare Department, Andhra Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Post-matric ITI, Polytechnic, Degree, Engineering, and PG students
data.benefits: 100% Full Tuition Fee reimbursement credited quarterly directly into the mother's bank account via Navasakam portal.
required_documents: Mother's Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar NPCI active)
CET Allotment Order and College Bonafide
data.application_procedure: 1. Verified through Navasakam Village/Ward Volunteer. 2. Jnanabhumi portal college verification.

data.name: Uttar Pradesh Post-Matric Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement Online System
data.ministry: Social Welfare / Backward Class / Minority Welfare Department, Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: UP Domicile students pursuing Class 11, 12, UG, PG and Professional Degrees
data.benefits: Tuition fee reimbursement + monthly non-refundable maintenance allowance directly disbursed through PFMS DBT.
required_documents: Income Certificate issued by eDistrict UP portal
Aadhaar Number (active OTP on registered mobile)
data.application_procedure: 1. Register at scholarship.up.gov.in. 2. Fill student details and authenticate Aadhaar. 3. Final submit to college.

data.name: Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means Scholarship (SVMCM)
data.ministry: Higher Education Department, Government of West Bengal
target_beneficiaries: Meritorious and economically backward students of West Bengal
data.benefits: Direct financial assistance of ₹1,000 to ₹8,000 per month depending on degree level.
required_documents: Marksheet of last qualifying exam (minimum 60% marks)
Income Certificate issued by BDO / SDO
data.application_procedure: 1. Register at svmcm.wbhed.gov.in. 2. Upload qualifying marksheet and income proof. 3. College verification.

data.name: Mukhyamantri Anuprati Coaching Yojana
data.ministry: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan
target_beneficiaries: Meritorious youth of Rajasthan preparing for competitive civil services & entrance exams
data.benefits: 100% Free coaching in top national institutions for UPSC, RPSC, JEE, NEET + ₹40,000 annual accommodation allowance.
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply via SSO Rajasthan portal (sso.rajasthan.gov.in) under SJMS application. 2. Enter Jan Aadhaar number.

data.name: Digital Gujarat Post-Matric Scholarships
data.ministry: Social Justice and Empowerment & Tribal Development, Government of Gujarat
target_beneficiaries: Gujarat domicile students pursuing post-secondary education
data.benefits: Full tuition fee reimbursement as prescribed by Fee Regulatory Committee (FRC) + book grant and hostel allowance.
required_documents: Caste Certificate issued by competent authority in Gujarat
Aadhaar Card and seeded bank account
data.application_procedure: 1. Register on Digital Gujarat portal (digitalgujarat.gov.in). 2. Complete student profile. 3. Lock application.

data.name: Suvarna Jubilee Merit Scholarship
data.ministry: Directorate of Collegiate Education, Government of Kerala
target_beneficiaries: First year UG and PG students from BPL families in Kerala
data.benefits: Annual scholarship of ₹10,000 for undergraduate and postgraduate students from BPL households.
required_documents: BPL Certificate issued by Local Self Government
Aadhaar Card and Bank Passbook copy
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply via DCE Scholarship Portal (dcescholarship.kerala.gov.in). 2. College verification by Principal.

data.name: KALIA Scholarship Scheme
data.ministry: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Empowerment, Government of Odisha
target_beneficiaries: Children of KALIA scheme beneficiaries (farmers & landless agri laborers)
data.benefits: Full tuition, hostel, and mess fee support for pursuing professional, technical, and general higher education courses.
required_documents: College Admission Allotment Letter and Fee receipt
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply via Odisha State Scholarship Portal (scholarship.odisha.gov.in). 2. Input parent's KALIA ID.

data.name: Bihar Student Credit Card Yojana (BSCCY)
data.ministry: Education Department, Government of Bihar (7 Nischay)
target_beneficiaries: Bihar domicile Class 12 pass students pursuing higher education
data.benefits: Education loan up to ₹4,00,000 at concessional interest rate (1% for women, disabled; 4% for others) with full state government guarantee.
required_documents: Class 10th and 12th Passing Certificates and Marksheets
Admission letter and fee schedule from recognized college
Aadhaar Card and PAN Card of student and co-applicant
data.application_procedure: 1. Register on MNSSBY portal (7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in). 2. Visit DRCC for document verification.

data.name: Ashirwad (Shagun) Scheme
data.ministry: Social Justice, Empowerment and Minorities, Government of Punjab
target_beneficiaries: Girls from SC, Christian, Backward Classes, and economically weaker families for marriage
data.benefits: One-time financial grant of ₹51,000 directly transferred to the bride or mother's bank account for marriage expenses.
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply online via eSewa Punjab or offline at District Social Justice and Empowerment Office.
data.application_deadline: Apply before or within 30 days after marriage

data.name: Pragyan Bharati Scheme (Free College Admission & Book Grant)
data.ministry: Higher Education Department, Government of Assam
target_beneficiaries: Assam domicile students studying in provincialized and government colleges
data.benefits: 100% Free admission fee, tuition fee, and examination fee in all provincialized colleges + annual book grant.
required_documents: Income Certificate (Family income < ₹2,00,000) or Ration Card
Proof of plantation of a sapling in home/college campus (Green initiative)
Previous year exam marksheet with > 75% attendance proof
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply via Assam Samarth portal (assamadmission.samarth.ac.in). 2. Submit income certificate during admission.

data.name: Rajiv Gandhi / Mukhyamantri Kisan Nyay Yojana
data.ministry: Department of Agriculture Development and Farmer Welfare, Government of Chhattisgarh
target_beneficiaries: Paddy, maize, kodo, kutki and sugarcane farmers in Chhattisgarh
data.benefits: Input subsidy of ₹9,000 to ₹10,000 per acre provided directly to farmers in four quarterly installments via DBT.
required_documents: B1 / P2 land records (Bhuiyan portal verified)
data.application_procedure: 1. Register on RGKNY portal (kisan.cg.nic.in) through Primary Agricultural Cooperative Society (PACS). 2. Verification of girawari crop area by Patwari.

data.name: Griha Aadhar Scheme
data.ministry: Directorate of Women and Child Development, Government of Goa
target_beneficiaries: Homemakers and housewives from poor, middle-class households in Goa
data.benefits: Monthly financial disbursement of ₹1,500 transferred directly to the woman's savings bank account to offset inflation.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card & Marriage Certificate / Ration Card
data.application_procedure: 1. Download form from goaonline.gov.in. 2. Submit with Mamlatdar income certificate at Taluka Women & Child Development office.

data.name: Mukhya Mantri Parivar Samridhi Yojana (MMPSY)
data.ministry: Citizen Resources Information Department (CRID), Government of Haryana
target_beneficiaries: Eligible families verified via Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) with income <= 1.80 Lakhs
data.benefits: Annual financial assistance of ₹6,000 per family for social security, pension contributions, and insurance premiums.
required_documents: Bank Account linked with Family ID
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply via Antyodaya Saral Haryana portal (saralharyana.gov.in) using Family ID. 2. Auto-fetched family income verification.

data.name: Mukhyamantri Yuba Jogayog Yojana
data.ministry: Department of Information Technology, Government of Tripura
target_beneficiaries: Final year undergraduate degree college students in Tripura
data.benefits: One-time financial grant of ₹5,000 transferred via DBT for purchasing internet-enabled smartphone/device for digital learning and employment search.
required_documents: Final year admission fee receipt and college identity card
GST Invoice of purchased smartphone in student's name
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply on BMS Portal (bms.tripura.gov.in). 2. Upload phone invoice and PRTC. 3. Verification by College Principal.

data.name: Nanda Gaura Yojana
data.ministry: Women Empowerment and Child Development Department, Government of Uttarakhand
target_beneficiaries: Girl children born in Uttarakhand and girls passing Class 12 from poor families
data.benefits: Financial assistance of ₹11,000 at the birth of a girl child and ₹51,000 after passing Class 12 for pursuing higher education.
required_documents: Class 12th passing marksheet and institutional certificate
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply online via eDistrict Uttarakhand (edistrict.uk.gov.in) or offline at Anganwadi / District Child Development Project Officer (CDPO).

data.name: Jai Bhim Mukhyamantri Pratibha Vikas Yojana
data.ministry: Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBC, Government of NCT of Delhi
target_beneficiaries: SC/ST/OBC/EWS students of Delhi preparing for premier competitive examinations
data.benefits: Full coaching fees paid directly to empaneled coaching institutes for up to 1 year + monthly stipend of ₹2,500.
required_documents: Caste Certificate issued by Revenue Department, Govt of NCT of Delhi
data.application_procedure: 1. Apply directly to empaneled coaching institutes or online via e-District Delhi portal (edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in).

data.name: Prime Minister's Special Scholarship Scheme (PMSSS J&K and Ladakh)
data.ministry: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) / Ministry of Education
target_beneficiaries: Domicile youth of UTs of J&K and Ladakh pursuing higher education outside J&K
data.benefits: Academic fee reimbursement up to ₹1,25,000/year for engineering directly to college + ₹1,00,000/year maintenance allowance directly to student.
required_documents: Class 12th Marksheet from JKBOSE or CBSE in J&K
data.application_procedure: 1. Register on AICTE PMSSS portal (aicte-jk-scholarship-gov.in). 2. Document verification at Facilitation Center.

data.name: Telangana Aasara Pension Scheme
data.ministry: Panchayat Raj and Rural Development Department, Government of Telangana
target_beneficiaries: Senior citizens (57+), widows, disabled persons, beedi workers
data.benefits: Monthly direct financial pension of ₹2,016 for seniors/widows and ₹3,016 for persons with disabilities.
data.application_procedure: Apply online via MeeSeva or submit physical dossier to Municipal Commissioner / MPDO office.

data.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Account (SSA)
data.ministry: Ministry of Finance & Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_beneficiaries: Girl children aged below 10 years through natural/legal guardians
data.benefits: High-yield sovereign small-savings account currently yielding 8.2% per annum compounding interest with triple tax exemption under Section 80C.
data.application_procedure: Open account at any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch.

data.name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
data.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Urban and peri-urban street vendors
data.benefits: Collateral-free working capital micro-credit starting at ₹10,000, progressing to ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 on timely repayments with 7% interest subsidy.
required_documents: Vending Certificate / Urban Local Body ID Card
data.application_procedure: Apply online through PM SVANidhi Portal or through Common Service Centres (CSCs).
